अनैक्य n. (क्यं)
 1. Plurality, the existence of many.
 2. Want of union,
anarchy.
 E. अनेक, and घञ् aff.

अनैकान्त mfn. (-न्तः-न्ता-न्तं)
 1. Variable, unsteady.
 2. (In logic) Oc-
casional, as a cause not invariably attended by the same effects. E.
अनेक, अन्त end, अण् aff.

अनैकान्तिक mfn. (-कः-की-कं) Unsteady, variable, having many objects or
purposes.
 E. अनेक, अन्त end, and ठक् aff.

आनैपुण n. (-णं) Clumsiness, stupidity.
 E. अनिपुण not dexterous, अण्
affix; and the initial optionally long.

आनैश्वर्य्य n. (-र्य्यं) Absence of power or supremacy.
 E. अनैश्वर्य्य the same,
and the initial optionally long.
